title: Economic Impact Modeler: System Overview
description: Signature-original system overview for the proposed Economic Impact Modeler system (entry 572).
body:
Economic Impact Modeler (entry 572 of the Ultimate Apex God-Mode Engineering System: Civilization-Scale Systems) is a Signature-original proposed capability. Simulates policy effects. Every entry in this system is built with the mix-and-match formula — one objective flows through six layers: intelligence, knowledge, creation, experiment, verification, and evolution.

It takes one objective — for example, cutting a city's flood risk in half within a decade — and builds the complete civilization-systems ecosystem around it.
